assessment.nobel_worthiness: Giant room-temperature tunnel magnetoresistance revealed decisive spin-dependent tunnelling physics and became foundational to modern magnetic memory technology.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio captures seminal experimental discovery, room-temperature development, and technologically consequential implementation.
assessment.maturity: The effect has been repeatedly reproduced, quantitatively understood, and deployed over decades.
uncertainties: The division of priority among early tunnelling-magnetoresistance experiments and later device advances requires careful historical review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Topological insulators transformed the understanding of electronic phases by connecting band topology to protected boundary transport.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele supplied the defining quantum-spin-Hall theory, while Molenkamp led a compelling experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The central physics is independently confirmed across materials and has generated a durable field.
uncertainties: A final attribution assessment must weigh additional foundational theorists and experimental groups.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory gave strongly correlated-electron physics a broadly predictive, quantitative framework bridging model Hamiltonians and real materials.
assessment.attribution: These names represent the central formulation, development, and establishment of the method.
assessment.maturity: DMFT is extensively benchmarked, used alongside electronic-structure calculations, and tested against measured spectra.
uncertainties: The contribution is methodological and distributed across a wider community, complicating a three-person award.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Iron-based high-temperature superconductors opened a major new family of unconventional superconductors and challenged established ideas about pairing.
assessment.attribution: Hosono and Kamihara are closely associated with the original material discovery.
assessment.maturity: The phenomenon is well established and continues to yield important comparative insight into high-temperature superconductivity.
uncertainties: The microscopic pairing mechanism remains incompletely settled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have reached extraordinary precision while controlling systematic shifts, redefining practical and fundamental time measurement.
assessment.attribution: Katori introduced the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept and Ye made defining experimental advances.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories now demonstrate mature performance and important applications in metrology and fundamental tests.
uncertainties: The appropriate boundary between the original clock concept and the broader precision-metrology community merits review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Aberration-corrected transmission electron microscopy made direct, quantitative atomic-scale imaging and spectroscopy broadly achievable.
assessment.attribution: Rose provided essential correction concepts, and Haider and Urban were central to practical instrument realization and materials impact.
assessment.maturity: The technology is robust, widely adopted, and has transformed experimental materials physics.
uncertainties: Several closely connected contributors to electron-optical correction may have strong claims.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: SASE X-ray free-electron lasers created a new source regime for ultrafast structural and electronic studies of matter.
assessment.attribution: The nominees represent central theoretical and accelerator-physics contributions behind the SASE concept and its realization.
assessment.maturity: Multiple facilities have confirmed the principle and enabled a large body of distinctive science.
uncertainties: Credit is distributed among theoretical pioneers, machine builders, and facility teams.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Negative-refraction metamaterials and transformation optics established an influential route to engineering electromagnetic response beyond natural materials.
assessment.attribution: Pendry supplied key theoretical ideas, while Smith and Zhang made prominent experimental demonstrations and extensions.
assessment.maturity: Core phenomena are experimentally established and have had lasting influence in photonics.
uncertainties: Some early claims and proposed applications proved more limited than initially expected.
